# VIT Student Portal - Implementation Plan

## Goal Description
Build a complete, premium-grade, cinematic dark-mode **VIT Student Portal** featuring instant roll number verification, secure student registration with anti-duplicate transaction safeguards, student dashboard with digital student ID cards, an administrative command panel for roll number management, and 20 bespoke GSAP/Lenis animations.

---

## User Review Required

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Dual-Engine Firebase & Instant Preview Architecture:**
> To ensure the application is 100% functional immediately upon opening the live preview link (without requiring an upfront command-line `firebase login` or manual cloud provisioning), the application implements a **Dual-Mode Persistence Layer**:
> 1. **Live Firebase Cloud Mode**: Supports standard Firebase project configuration (`apiKey`, `projectId`, `authDomain`, `firestore`, `auth`, `functions`).
> 2. **Deterministic Sandbox Engine**: Pre-loaded with official VIT test credentials, approved roll numbers (e.g. `21BCE1024`, `22MIS0045`, `20BEE0112`), and an admin account (`admin@vit.ac.in` / `Admin@VIT2026!`). Any new registrations or roll additions persist seamlessly in `localStorage`/IndexedDB if live cloud keys are not populated, or write directly to Cloud Firestore when live keys are provided.
> 3. Production **Firebase Cloud Functions** (`functions/index.js`) and **Firestore Security Rules** (`firestore.rules`) are provided for direct Firebase CLI deployment.

> [!NOTE]
> **Live Site URL:**
> https://antigravity.luch.dev/site/9ae2b0d4-cfdb-4773-85be-b254ec499038/22129fd0984a773f71a6dcb1/

---

## Architecture Overview

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    subgraph UI ["Frontend (HTML5 + CSS3 + GSAP + Lenis)"]
        A["Home Page (index.html)"] --> B["Verify Roll (verify.html)"]
        A --> C["Register (register.html)"]
        A --> D["Login (login.html)"]
        D --> E["Student Dashboard (dashboard.html)"]
        D --> F["Admin Command Center (admin.html)"]
    end

    subgraph Logic ["Application Services (js/)"]
        AuthService["auth.js (Session & Auth Guards)"]
        VerifyService["verify.js (Roll Verification Engine)"]
        RegisterService["register.js (Validation & Claims)"]
        AdminService["admin.js (CSV / Analytics / Roll Management)"]
        AnimEngine["animations.js (20 GSAP Effects & Lenis)"]
    end

    subgraph FirebaseLayer ["Firebase Backend & Persistence"]
        FirebaseConfig["firebase-config.js"]
        CF["Cloud Functions (functions/index.js)"]
        Rules["firestore.rules"]
        ColApproved["approved_roll_numbers"]
        ColStudents["students"]
        ColClaims["roll_number_claims"]
        ColAdmins["admins"]
    end

    B --> VerifyService --> FirebaseConfig
    C --> RegisterService --> FirebaseConfig
    D --> AuthService --> FirebaseConfig
    E --> AuthService & FirebaseConfig
    F --> AdminService --> FirebaseConfig
    FirebaseConfig --> CF
    FirebaseConfig --> ColApproved & ColStudents & ColClaims & ColAdmins
```

| 2 | **Split Text** | Character/word spans with GSAP stagger reveal |
| 3 | **Smooth Page Transitions** | Overlay curtain fade & scale transition on page navigation |
| 4 | **Scroll Reveal** | `ScrollTrigger.batch` with cubic-bezier easing |
| 5 | **Parallax Scrolling** | Background glow orbs and floating badges mapped to scroll velocity |
| 6 | **3D Card Hover** | Dynamic mousemove tilt with perspective, sheen highlight & transform matrix |

| 13 | **Navbar Entrance** | Slide-down glassmorphism with blur backdrop reveal on initial load |

## Proposed Changes

### Component 1: Core Layout & Pages

#### `[MODIFY] index.html`
- Transform into the **VIT Student Portal Landing Page**.
- Include cinematic loading screen with VIT Crest.
- Header with modern glassmorphism navigation (Home, Register, Verify Roll, Login, Dashboard, Admin).
- Hero section with animated heading, live metrics counters, magnetic CTA buttons ("Register Account", "Verify Roll Number").
- Features Showcase: Roll verification protocol, Cloud Functions security, tamper-proof audit trails.
- About section: Academic identity verification architecture.
- Live Status HUD: Shows system connectivity and real-time response latency.
- Futuristic footer with university credits and quick links.

#### `[NEW] register.html` & `[NEW] public/register.html`
- Futuristic registration form:
  - Full Name, VIT Roll Number (e.g. `21BCE1024`), Student Email, Password, Confirm Password.
- Real-time roll number validity badge (checks if roll number is approved by admin and not yet claimed).
- Password strength indicator (length, special characters, uppercase, numbers).
- Error notifications with animated shake.
- Success celebration modal with confetti and direct redirect to Login / Dashboard.

#### `[NEW] verify.html` & `[NEW] public/verify.html`
- Dedicated Roll Number Verification portal.
- Single roll input with instant search / verification button.
- Comprehensive result states:
  - `Valid & Unclaimed` (Approved roll number, ready to register)
  - `Already Registered` (Approved roll number claimed by registered student)
  - `Invalid Roll Number` (Not found in university approved registry)
- Privacy-compliant response (no leak of sensitive personal data).
- Direct "Proceed to Registration" CTA when valid.

#### `[NEW] login.html` & `[NEW] public/login.html`
- Unified login interface for both Students and Administrators.
- Email and password authentication with "Remember Me" session toggle.
- Tabbed or role-detected navigation (auto-detects admin vs student account).
- "Forgot Password?" modal with Firebase password reset email flow.
- Quick test credentials panel for one-click testing in live preview mode.

#### `[NEW] dashboard.html` & `[NEW] public/dashboard.html`
- Student personal portal:
  - Personalized welcome banner with time-of-day greeting.
  - Holographic 3D Digital Student Identity Card (VIT Crest, student name, roll number, department, QR Code generated with `qrcode.js`).
  - Account status badges (Verified, Active, Academic Year).
  - Profile settings section with password change and session history.
  - Quick action to roll number verification.
  - Secure logout button.

#### `[NEW] admin.html` & `[NEW] public/admin.html`
- Admin Command Center (protected by admin authentication):
  - Telemetry bar: Total Approved, Registered Students, Verified Count, Pending Rolls.
  - Search & filter student registry with real-time text query.
  - Add individual approved roll numbers modal (Roll Number, Full Name, Department, Year).
  - Bulk CSV Roll Number uploader (drag & drop or file browse with parser & preview).
  - Delete / revoke roll numbers.
  - Student details modal/drawer (view full registration details).
  - Export Student Records to CSV.
  - Pre-seed sample VIT cohort data button for instant testing.

---

### Component 2: CSS Stylesheets

#### `[MODIFY] css/style.css`
- Core futuristic dark theme:
  - Deep space black and navy backgrounds (`#030712`, `#060b19`, `#0a1128`).
  - Glassmorphic panels (`backdrop-filter: blur(16px)`, `border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08)`).
  - Neon accent palettes: Electric VIT Cyan (`#00f0ff`), Cobalt Royal Blue (`#3b82f6`), Emerald Success (`#10b981`), Crimson Alert (`#ef4444`), Violet Accent (`#8b5cf6`).
  - Typography: Syne, Space Grotesk, Inter, JetBrains Mono.
  - Premium ID Card styling with foil sheen and QR code.

#### `[NEW] css/animations.css`
- Keyframe animations, glowing border pulses, floating element physics, cursor rings, preloader transitions, modal pop animations, and `prefers-reduced-motion` overrides.

#### `[NEW] css/responsive.css`
- Strict media query breakpoints (`<480px`, `<768px`, `<1024px`, `<1280px`).
- Mobile hamburger menu, drawer slide-outs, flexible grid stacking, touch-optimized button hit areas.

---

### Component 3: JavaScript Modules

#### `[NEW] js/firebase-config.js`
- Firebase SDK initialization with configuration manager.
- Pre-configured demo keys + LocalStorage config override modal.
- Dual-mode data manager: reads/writes to Firebase Firestore or fallback local state with identical schema (`approved_roll_numbers`, `students`, `admins`, `roll_number_claims`).
- Pre-seeds initial VIT approved roll numbers (`21BCE1024`, `21BCE1088`, `22MIS0045`, `20BEE0112`, etc.) and admin account.

#### `[NEW] js/auth.js`
- User authentication management:
  - `loginUser(email, password)`
  - `registerUser(name, rollNumber, email, password)`
  - `logoutUser()`
  - `sendPasswordReset(email)`
  - `requireStudentAuth(callback)`
  - `requireAdminAuth(callback)`

#### `[NEW] js/register.js`
- Registration form handling:
  - Real-time field validation (VIT roll regex `^[0-9]{2}[A-Z]{3}[0-9]{4}$`, email format, strong password check).
  - Live debounce verification of roll number against `approved_roll_numbers` and `roll_number_claims`.
  - Atomic registration transaction call.
  - Success modal trigger and redirection.

#### `[NEW] js/verify.js`
- Verification page logic:
  - Format formatting and auto-capitalization of roll numbers.
  - Query approved roll numbers and claims.
  - Render status cards with color-coded badges and descriptions.

#### `[NEW] js/dashboard.js`
- Loads current authenticated student's profile.
- Renders dynamic Digital Student ID Card with QR code verification hash.
- Provides interactive 3D card tilt effect.
- Handles profile update and logout.

#### `[NEW] js/admin.js`
- Admin session guard.
- Metric calculation and display.
- Data table rendering with instant search, department filters, and pagination.
- Manual roll number insertion with validation.
- CSV parser for bulk uploads with error handling.
- CSV export generator for all registered student records.
- Invalidation / deletion of roll numbers.

#### `[NEW] js/animations.js`
- Lenis smooth scroll engine setup.
- GSAP initialization for all 20 animation types.
- Canvas background particles and ambient light field.
- Custom cursor element and magnetic button logic.
- Reduced-motion detection.

---

### Component 4: Cloud Functions & Security Rules

#### `[NEW] functions/index.js`
- `verifyRollNumber`: HTTPS callable function to check status without exposing full database records.
- `registerStudentWithRoll`: Atomic transaction ensuring:
  1. Roll number exists in `approved_roll_numbers`.
  2. Roll number does not exist in `roll_number_claims`.
  3. Writes student record to `students` and registers claim in `roll_number_claims`.
  4. Marks `approved_roll_numbers[rollNumber].isRegistered = true`.
- `setAdminRole`: Server-side custom claim setter for admins.

#### `[NEW] functions/package.json`
- Dependencies: `firebase-admin`, `firebase-functions`.

#### `[NEW] firestore.rules`
- Strict security rules ensuring:
  - Public can only query their own roll number claim status.
  - Authenticated students can only read and update their own `students/{uid}` document.
  - Only users with admin credentials can read/write `approved_roll_numbers` and `admins`.
  - Prevent unauthorized client-side updates to claims.

#### `[NEW] firebase.json`
- Hosting, Firestore, and Functions deployment specifications.

---

## Verification Plan

### Automated / Syntax Verification
- Run Node.js syntax checks on all JavaScript files:
  ```bash
  node -c js/firebase-config.js
  node -c js/auth.js
  node -c js/register.js
  node -c js/verify.js
  node -c js/dashboard.js
  node -c js/admin.js
  node -c js/animations.js
  node -c functions/index.js
  ```
- Validate HTML structure with automated tag and script link verification.

### Manual Verification Flows
1. **Landing Page (`index.html`)**:
   - Check loading screen animation, VIT Crest glow, Lenis smooth scrolling.
   - Verify all 20 animation triggers (text reveals, 3D card tilt, magnetic buttons, cursor follower, background canvas).
   - Test navigation links to all subpages.
2. **Roll Number Verification (`verify.html`)**:
   - Test with approved unclaimed roll (`21BCE1024`): Expect "Valid Roll Number - Not Yet Registered".
   - Test with invalid roll (`99XYZ9999`): Expect "Invalid Roll Number".
   - Test with already registered roll: Expect "Already Registered".
3. **Student Registration (`register.html`)**:
   - Test registration validation (invalid roll format, mismatching passwords).
   - Register a valid roll number (`21BCE1024`): Verify atomic claim, success celebration popup, and redirect.
   - Try re-registering `21BCE1024`: Verify duplicate prevention warning is triggered.
4. **Student Dashboard (`dashboard.html`)**:
   - Verify unauthenticated visit redirects to `login.html`.
   - Log in with newly created student: Verify welcome greeting, details, digital ID card with working QR code.
   - Test logout button.
5. **Admin Dashboard (`admin.html`)**:
   - Log in with admin credentials (`admin@vit.ac.in`).
   - Check dynamic metrics (Total Approved, Registered, Pending).
   - Add a new approved roll number (`24BCE9999`).
   - Upload sample CSV and verify bulk import.
   - Test search filter on student roster.
   - Test Export to CSV functionality.
6. **Responsive Design Verification**:
   - Verify mobile viewport layouts on screens from 375px to 1920px.
